Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the heads-up and the deck. Unfortunately our VP of Clinical Ops (who we really want on the call) was just booked onto a site visit that overlaps Thursday morning. We only found out today — apologies for the late notice.

Options from our side:
1) Move the demo to Friday afternoon (prefer 1:00–3:00 ET).
2) Keep Thursday but record the walkthrough — then schedule a 30-min live Q&A next week with the VP included.
3) If neither works, we can push entirely to the following week.

We really want to avoid losing momentum; option 2 might be the least disruptive. If you can record the session and share a 20–25 minute highlight clip, we’ll watch internally and send any questions to collect for the Q&A.

Hi Priya —

Totally understand — thanks for the quick update. Option 2 works well for us and keeps things moving. Proposed plan:

- We’ll run the scheduled live demo Thursday at 11:30 PT as planned but record it and produce a ~22-minute trimmed highlight (key flows + config notes).
- Deliverables by Friday 2pm ET: full recording (private link), 22-min highlight clip, and a short doc with timestamps and recommended follow-ups.
- Schedule a 30-min live Q&A week of June 29 — please share 2 preferred windows and we’ll lock one.

So that we can tailor the highlight clip, could you confirm the three practical scenarios you most want to see (from your earlier note I captured):
1) Automated intake summarization for outpatient referrals
2) Pre-visit triage prompt flow + fallbacks
3) Redaction & logging policy example for PHI handling

Soojin — can you run the recording + create the highlight clip and a one-page follow-up doc? I’ll leave the scheduling Q&A follow-up to you and Lifecorps Scheduling.

If that sounds good, I’ll mark the calendar as recording-only for Thursday and we’ll deliver Friday.

Thanks —
Marcus
